items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: but now modern music with this post-Wynton Marsalis invasion

ctx.x: Right. When you look at the audience.

Yeah well it’s the audience. And my late brother died a couple of years ago would be at 60 or 61 now, and he died a couple of years ago. He rode around in his car listening to 50s R&B. People 55 years old now talk about Grand Funk Railroad or whoever. They don’t know. People crowding 60 have had no exposure to this music. They don’t know beans about it. And that really doesn’t bode very well for us, but now modern music with this post-Wynton Marsalis invasion — it’s not an invasion it’s just people have gotten…
You don’t want to hear jazz and Irish reels together.
